id_namespace_notice: rite:* catalog IDs and logger:rite:* stat IDs are internal application identifiers derived from published content; they are not game IDs.
coverage: All 73 published rows in PoE2DB's Rite of the Nameless table: 60 Foretold Bounty variants, 6 Foretold Proliferation variants, 6 local effects, and 1 raw very-rare-unique flag. Published membership does not establish live league eligibility or roll weights.
proliferation_rule: After completing its map, a Foretold Proliferation modifier applies its specified effect to other remaining maps in the same Rite of the Nameless. Local effects and Foretold Bounty do not proliferate.
untranslated_notice: Three source rows are raw stat labels. Their original wording and numeric values are preserved without claiming a translated game effect or a game stat ID.
